blocks.text: B1-20 · The Connectives of Discourse
Lesson overview

A text is not a list of phrases: it is a chain of ideas linked by relationships (addition, contrast, cause, consequence, example, conclusion). The words that make these relationships visible are the connective ( ⁧الرَّوَابِط⁩ ): ⁧لِذٰلِكَ⁩ Therefore, this Regulation shall enter into force on the day following that of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union. ⁧بَيْنَمَا⁩ • while • ⁧عِلَاوَةً عَلَى ذٰلِكَ⁩ In addition to this, the following definitions shall apply: ⁧رَغْمَ⁩ “despite”. The reader uses them as a sign to follow the reasoning; who writes uses them to build it. In this unit you order by function the connectives you already know, learn new ones, and above all learn their syntax: which want a name, such as a phrase with ⁧أَنَّ⁩ , such as a verb. It is the basis of the module B1.4, where you will write summaries, formal letters and argumentative texts. Two weeks.

rows: 12–14 hours · two weeks (weeks 137–138), plus the EGY track

blocks.text: Materials This unit, Grammar G56, script for speech synthesis, session with tutor
Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. recognize the function of a connective (addition, contrast, concession, cause, consequence, purpose,
time, example, rewording, conclusion, opinion);
2. choose between named form and phrased form ( ⁧رَغْمَ⁩ / ⁧رَغْمَ أَنَّ⁩ , ⁧بِسَبَبِ⁩ / ⁧لِأَنَّ⁩ , ⁧بَعْدَ⁩ / ⁧بَعْدَ أَنْ⁩ );
3. Use correctly ⁧أَمَّا⁩ … ⁧فَـ⁩ , ⁧إِلَّا أَنَّ⁩ , ⁧بَلْ⁩ , ⁧بَيْنَمَا⁩ , ⁧لِكَيْ⁩ ;
4. follow the structure of an argumentative text through its connectors;
5. write an argumentative paragraph of 120–150 well-connected words.
Two-week plan.

2. What Connectives Are Used for

rows: because of · because of · since · since
in short · in conclusion · in short

blocks.text: opinion ⁧يَبْدُو أَنَّ⁩ · ⁧أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ⁩ · ⁧فِي رَأْيِي⁩ in my opinion · I believe that · it seems that

Read with the connectors. Before reading an article, scroll through the text and highlight the connectives: they tell you where a new topic begins ( ⁧أَمَّا⁩ , ⁧مِنْ جِهَةٍ أُخْرَى⁩ ), where an objection comes ( ⁧إِلَّا أَنَّ⁩ , ⁧غَيْرَ أَنَّ⁩ ), where the conclusion stands ( ⁧فِي الخِتَامِ⁩ , ⁧وَهٰكَذَا⁩ ). It's the map of the text.

7. Purpose, time and sequence
The purpose. ⁧لِكَيْ⁩ · ⁧كَيْ⁩ · ⁧لِـ⁩ + conjunctive: ⁧أَدْرُسُ لِكَيْ أَنْجَحَ⁩ · ⁧مِنْ أَجْلِ⁩ · ⁧بِهَدَفِ⁩ + name (maṣdar): ⁧مِنْ أَجْلِ النَّجَاحِ⁩ , ⁧بِهَدَفِ⁩
⁧تَحْسِينِ الخَدَمَاتِ.⁩

The sequence. ⁧أَوَّلًا⁩ · ⁧ثَانِيًا⁩ · ⁧ثَالِثًا⁩ · ⁧فِي البِدَايَةِ⁩ · ⁧ثُمَّ⁩ · ⁧بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ⁩ · ⁧فِي الوَقْتِ نَفْسِهِ⁩ · ⁧أَخِيرًا⁩ · ⁧فِي النِّهَايَةِ.⁩ Time in the story. ⁧قَبْلَ⁩ / ⁧بَعْدَ⁩ + name · ⁧قَبْلَ أَنْ⁩ / ⁧بَعْدَ أَنْ⁩ + verb · ⁧عِنْدَمَا⁩ · ⁧حِينَ⁩ · ⁧مُنْذُ ذٰلِكَ الحِينِ⁩ Since then, it has been ⁧آنَذَاكَ⁩ Then, at that time, it was: ⁧كُنْتُ آنَذَاكَ طَالِبًا⁩ At that time I was a student.

blocks.text: alternative ... ⁧أَمْ⁩ … ⁧سَوَاءٌ⁩ whether or not...

⁧سَوَاءٌ⁩ … ⁧أَمْ⁩ introduces two possibilities that do not change the result: ⁧يَجِبُ أَنْ نُغَيِّرَ عَادَاتِنَا، سَوَاءٌ فِي البَيْتِ أَمْ فِي العَمَلِ⁩ We need to change habits, both at home and at work. ⁧عِلْمًا بِأَنَّ⁩ adds information to be taken into account: ⁧التَّسْجِيلُ مَفْتُوحٌ، عِلْمًا بِأَنَّ الأَمَاكِنَ مَحْدُودَةٌ⁩ The entries shall be open; It should be noted that the posts are limited ( ⁧مَحْدُود⁩ (i.e. limited).
9. Syntax of Connectives
Many connections exist in two forms: one followed by a name (or maṣdar), the other from one sentence.

rows: despite the rain · although it rains hard
because of traffic · because the road is busy

blocks.text: ⁧بَعْدَ أَنِ انْتَهَتِ الاِمْتِحَانَاتُبَعْدَ الاِمْتِحَانَاتِ⁩ after the examinations · after the tests have been completed

rows: seen the train's delay · since the train is late

blocks.text: Four rules not to be forgotten.
1. After ⁧أَنَّ⁩ , ⁧لِأَنَّ⁩ , ⁧لٰكِنَّ⁩ , ⁧إِلَّا أَنَّ⁩ the subject goes to the accusative: ⁧إِلَّا أَنَّ الوَزِيرَ رَفَضَ.⁩
2. After ⁧أَنْ⁩ , ⁧لِكَيْ⁩ , ⁧كَيْ⁩ , ⁧لِـ⁩ (purpose) the verb goes to the conjunctive: ⁧لِكَيْ يَنْجَحُوا⁩ (not ⁧يَنْجَحُونَ⁩ ).
3. After ⁧أَمَّا⁩ + name needed ⁧فَـ⁩ : ⁧أَمَّا الأَسْعَارُ فَمُرْتَفِعَةٌ.⁩
4. After ⁧بَلْ⁩ It corrects what has been denied: ⁧لَمْ يَحْضُرِ الوَزِيرُ، بَلْ أَرْسَلَ نَائِبَهُ.⁩
10. Pronunciation

Pause after connective tissue. Connectives at the beginning of the sentence separate with a small pause (and a comma in the writing): wa-maʿa ḏālika (Pause) uḥibbu Mīlānū · ʿilāwatan ʿalā ḏālika This is how the listener understands the structure of the speech. ⁧أَمَّا⁩ … ⁧فَـ⁩ . The intonation rises to ⁧أَمَّا⁩ + name and descent after ⁧فَـ⁩ : ammā l-ǧanūbu (↗) fa-ḥārr (↘).
